{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
df['customer_age'] = df['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
df = df[~qa_mask]
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'
df = df[completed_mask]

# Compute conversion rates by channel and segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print("\nConversion rates by channel and segment:")
print(conversion_by_channel_segment)

# Pivot to compute differences
pivot = conversion_by_channel_segment.pivot(index='customer_segment', columns='channel', values='converted')
pivot['diff'] = pivot['email'] - pivot['paid_search']
print("\nWithin-segment differences (email - paid_search):")
print(pivot[['diff']])

# Compute weighted average difference
segment_counts = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].count()
total_n = segment_counts.sum()
weights = segment_counts / total_n
weighted_diff = (pivot['diff'] * weights).sum()
print(f"\nWeighted average difference (email - paid_search): {weighted_diff:.4f}")

# Compute raw channel differences
email_conv = df[df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_conv = df[df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
raw_diff = email_conv - paid_search_conv
print(f"\nRaw difference in conversion rate (email - paid_search): {raw_diff:.4f}")

# Compute average revenue by channel
email_rev = df[df['channel'] == 'email']['revenue'].mean()
paid_search_rev = df[df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue'].mean()
rev_diff = email_rev - paid_search_rev
print(f"\nDifference in average revenue: {rev_diff:.2f}")"}
